title: CINDER UncertaintyCarrier annotation
description: Posterior-summary UC bundle per PROTOCOL_DRAFT_v3 §4.7. Wire-compatible with the `uc.v1.bayes` schema vendored from 2ndOpinionMD-MVP `server/eoh/uc.py` (commit 00eaa9eb). Adds the §4.7 5-component mapping (signal density, evidence strength, anticipation flag, widening flag, refusal flag) on top of the core posterior fields.

hypothesis_id.description: Hypothesis identifier. Default CINDER set: `flare_30d`, `progression_3mo`, `taper_safety`. Custom IDs allowed when prior + likelihood_spec are supplied.

point_estimate.description: Posterior mean. For Beta-Bernoulli on a probability hypothesis, value is in [0, 1].

confidence.description: Stability score in [0, 1] derived from band width via `confidence_from_band`. 1 = sharp posterior, 0 = diffuse.

confidence_label.description: Legacy categorical label derived from `confidence` numeric.

basis.description: Human-readable reasons / spec hash / lineage tags. Must include `spec_hash=<hash>` and at least one evidence summary line.

evidence_event_ids.description: PTV event_ids the update conditioned on. Must be a subset of the input PTV's events.

method.description: Kernel tag identifying the math used.

prior.description: Full prior specification (family, parameters, source, notes).

source.description: Provenance: weak = strategy-doc default; mkg = population prior from sidecar table; clinician = manual override (requires reason + discovered_by).

posterior_params.description: Full posterior parameters in the same family as the prior.

likelihood_summary.description: Summary of evidence aggregation: rule hits, weighted counts, salience usage.

spec_hash.description: SHA-256 prefix of canonical JSON of (prior + likelihood_spec). Format: `uc_<16-hex-chars>`.

schema.description: Schema version. Pinned to vendored MVP shape.

cinder_components.description: CINDER §4.7 5-component UC mapping. These are derived from the core fields above; they live alongside for explicit protocol compliance.

signal_density.description: Proportion of expected PRO item fields present in prior K=2 waves. [0, 1].

evidence_strength.description: Magnitude of PRO shift relative to MCID, summed across qualifying domains.

anticipation_flag.description: Set when posterior predictive widened in the wave preceding the detected event (P4 pattern, §4.7).

widening_flag.description: Set when posterior predictive widening occurred in the absence of detection (P5 pattern, §4.7).

refusal_flag.description: Set when underlying evidence was insufficient to support detection or non-detection. Refusal is a first-class outcome per §4.7.
